I set out to transform my desk into the computer setup of my dreams, and mounting my monitors was essential. After hours of assembly, disaster struck: I remembered that the HP Omen X 27 requires a proprietary VESA adapter—and I had likely thrown mine away. Two disappointing Amazon replacements and several wasted weeks later, I turned to Etsy as a last-ditch effort. I’m thrilled to say Luka’s adapter actually worked! It saved my setup and allowed me to finally achieve the clean, spacious desk I envisioned. Shame on HP for the proprietary nonsense, but huge thanks to Luka for providing such a well-made, custom 3D-printed solution. You are the GOAT!
